uncertainty_selection.rule: maximize min over scenarios of p10 terminal wealth (robust 1/2 Kelly); tie -> higher mean log growth

policy.description: A: flat $10 unit when nominal net edge >= 0.05
B: 2% of bankroll when nominal net edge >= 0.05
C: full Kelly on the nominal model probability
F: robust Kelly: worst-case expected log wealth over the uncertainty set
G: nominal Kelly subject to E[(W'/W)^-lambda] <= 1, alpha 0.7, beta 0.1 (Busseti, Ryu and Boyd 2016)
G variant: robust 1/2 Kelly with the robust drawdown constraint (alpha 0.7, beta 0.1)
H: joint robust 1/2 Kelly over every candidate of a cluster, shared cluster budget
H variant: joint robust 1/2 Kelly + robust drawdown constraint (alpha 0.7, beta 0.1)

sweeps.meaning: calibration error: model log-odds multiplied by tau
